# Android Solid Services

> Single Solid sign-in for the Android ecosystem — SDK and app for accessing Solid pods.

Android Solid Services gives Android apps a single Solid sign-in. One app holds the user's pod accounts; every other app reaches those pods through it over AIDL, with the user's permission and without handling a credential.

- [Quickstart](https://androidsolidservices.erfangholami.com/0.7/start/quickstart/index.md)
